outcome: Neurodevelopmental status at 2 years of corrected age
cohort: 72 women with uncomplicated monochorionic diamniotic pregnancies between 32.0 and 37.6 weeks of gestation
finding: In uncomplicated monochorionic diamniotic twins at ≥ 32 weeks of gestation, planned vaginal delivery appears safe, with a high success rate and no significant increase in perinatal morbidity compared to planned cesarean section.
mod_finding: Planned vaginal delivery, whether induced or spontaneous, did not lead to a higher rate of composite perinatal morbidity.
